mapper.select: SELECT m.MEMBER_ID as memberId, m.NAME as name, m.EMAIL as email, m.PHONE as phone, l.LAWYER_ID as lawyerId, l.LICENSE_NO as licenseNo, l.SPECIALTY as specialty, l.INTRO as intro, l.OFFICE_NAME as officeName, l.CONSULT_FEE as consultFee, l.AVG_RATING as avgRating, l.REVIEW_CNT as reviewCnt, a.ATTACH_ID as attachId, a.SAVE_PATH as savePath, a.ORIG_NAME as origName FROM TB_MEMBER m INNER JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACHMENT a ON l.LAWYER_ID = a.REF_ID AND a.REF_TYPE = 'LAWYER' WHERE l.APPROVE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND m.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY l.AVG_RATING DESC, l.REVIEW_CNT DESC

SELECT m.MEMBER_ID as memberId, m.NAME as name, m.EMAIL as email, m.PHONE as phone, l.LAWYER_ID as lawyerId, l.LICENSE_NO as licenseNo, l.SPECIALTY as specialty, l.INTRO as intro, l.CAREER as career, l.OFFICE_NAME as officeName, l.OFFICE_ADDR as officeAddr, l.CONSULT_FEE as consultFee, l.AVG_RATING as avgRating, l.REVIEW_CNT as reviewCnt, a.ATTACH_ID as attachId, a.SAVE_PATH as savePath FROM TB_MEMBER m INNER JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACHMENT a ON l.LAWYER_ID = a.REF_ID AND a.REF_TYPE = 'LAWYER' WHERE l.LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId}
SELECT m.NAME as name, l.* FROM TB_MEMBER m JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON m.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID WHERE l.APPROVE_STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY l.CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_LAWYER ( LAWYER_ID, MEMBER_ID, LICENSE_NO, SPECIALTY, OFFICE_NAME, APPROVE_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_LAWYER.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{licenseNo}, #{specialty}, #{officeName}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
